name: Ogasawara (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ogasawara village emblem in blue: a disc bearing two white stylised birds.
history: Municipal flag of Ogasawara, a village in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 June 1983.

features.role: Ogasawara village emblem — a disc bearing two white stylised birds
